SELECTED_INDEX: 3
CONFIDENCE: 0.58
EXPLANATION: Strong mixed C–H stretch pattern (sp3 at 2879–2971 and vinylic sp2 at 3031–3048; GFQ-003) plus two intense C=C/C=O region bands at 1622 and 1643 cm⁻¹ are consistent with a conjugated enone/dicarbonyl. The pronounced 963 cm⁻¹ band is characteristic of the trans CH=CH wag, matching the E-configured alkenes in candidate 3; additional out-of-plane vinylic C–H bends at 758 and 817 cm⁻¹ support alkene substitution. Absence of a clear O–H/N–H stretch (~3200–3600; GFQ-001/002) disfavors candidates bearing OH/NH.
